title: Data Analyst -  2 year FTC
description:
Reed Technology is partnering with a leading health data and research organisation to recruit a Data Analyst.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a specialist data team responsible for managing and delivering access to large-scale healthcare datasets. Working with both structured and unstructured data, you will support the delivery of high-quality datasets for research and innovation projects that help improve health outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the maintenance and development of large-scale data repositories containing healthcare and research data.
  • Process, cleanse, validate and transform structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Perform ETL activities to integrate data into central repositories.
  • Work directly with researchers, clinicians and project teams to understand data requirements and deliver appropriate solutions.
  • Provide data feasibility assessments and support projects from initial scoping through to dataset delivery.
  • Optimise database queries and contribute to the ongoing performance and reliability of data platforms.
  • Ensure data quality standards and governance requirements are maintained throughout the data lifecycle.

Requirements

  • Experience working with ETL processes and data integration activities.
  • SQL skills, including experience working with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Experience writing and maintaining data transformation and extraction scripts.
  • Ability to analyse complex datasets and identify data quality issues.
  • Experience optimising database queries and improving data processing performance.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality outputs.

What's on Offer?

  • Permanent position.
  • Salary of £26,707 - £30,378 per annum.
  • Opportunity to work with large-scale, real-world datasets that support impactful research and innovation.
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Ongoing professional development and learning opportunities.
